changes: The public cylinder radiation example is calculated with explicit expansion-refinement targets.
All motion-mode long-wave comparators are shown separately from observed diffraction results.
Missing mass, metocean, damping and independent reference evidence is registered before wider design use.
Unsupported source-retrieval wording is removed so the source register matches retained evidence.
Text is read as UTF-8 and written with LF endings; new measurements use portable memory information and the current UTC date.
Comment identity follows displayed numerical precision, while cached calculations retain full-precision integrity checks.
Refinement uses the lowest and highest mode counts; rebuilt-report checks detect stale narrative and the draft is addressed to maintainers.
